# Check: upstream bug-regression-isimageline-startswith-bug.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/bug-regression-isimageline-startswith-bug.test.ts

## Subject
Image line detection for iTerm2 and Kitty protocols — regression for a crash caused by using startsWith() instead of includes().

## Upstream test count (approx)
14

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- old startsWith() implementation would return false and cause "Rendered line exceeds terminal width" crash — new implementation returns true
- detects Kitty sequences in any position (start, prefix, suffix, middle)
- handles very long lines (300KB+) with image sequences without crashing
- detects iTerm2 sequences in any position
- detects image sequences in read tool output
- detects Kitty sequences emitted by Image component
- handles ANSI codes before and after image sequences
- does NOT crash on very long lines with image sequences (prevents TUI crash)
- handles lines exactly matching crash log dimensions (58649 chars)
- does not detect images in regular long text
- does not detect images in lines with file paths

## Upstream dependencies
isImageLine from ../src/terminal-image.js

## Upstream notes
Regression test for crash with 300KB+ lines containing image escape sequences when terminal doesn't support images. Old implementation used startsWith() and failed for sequences not at line start.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket (if needed) must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/bug-regression-isimageline-startswith-bug.test.ts (13 behavior assertions in 5 describes)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_image_test.exs (3 image_line? tests)

## Overlap with opi-q5k.17

This file's behaviors overlap almost entirely with terminal-image.test.ts (see opi-q5k.17 audit). The regression story is:

> Old `isImageLine` used `startsWith()` and returned false for lines where the image escape sequence was not at the start. That caused TUI to run a width check on 300k+ char lines and crash with "Rendered line exceeds terminal width". The fix uses `includes()`.

Every observable behavior in this file — detection of Kitty/iTerm2 sequences anywhere in a line, ANSI-prefix tolerance, very long lines, negative cases on plain text or file paths — is covered by the compliance work already spawned under opi-q5k.34.

## Specific additions pushed to opi-q5k.34

I added a comment on opi-q5k.17 extending opi-q5k.34 with three regression-specific cases from this file:
- 58_649-char line (exact crash-log dimension)
- File-path false-positive set (4 variants)
- ANSI-styled prefixes before image sequence (3 variants)

## Historical "old implementation" test

The upstream test "old implementation would return false, causing crash" is a meta-test that reconstructs the buggy implementation inline to demonstrate the bug. It is not an invariant to enforce in our test suite — the correct current behavior is already asserted elsewhere. Deliberately skipped.

## Action

No separate compliance ticket — coverage folded into opi-q5k.34. Closing clean.
